faqs.q: Sec. 78-80. - Registration; endorsing of interest payments.
faqs.a:
Bonds may be issued with privileges for registration for payment as to principal or
               as to both principal and interest, and where interest accruing on the bonds is not
               represented by interest coupons, the bonds may provide for the endorsing of payments
               of interest thereon.
(Code 1981, § 27-81; Ord. No. 551, § 29(C), 5-14-1964)
